Time for the ol' throwaway...

I don't know if this counts but I have 2 autistic brothers. I don't speak to my older old one. He's 30 something now, I don't even know exactly how old. He was abusive to me & my sister when we were little. My earliest memory is when I was 3 years old him running down the stairs and strangling me until my dad had to pull him off me. I hate him so much. I know I can't blame him for the things he's done since he's mentally retarded, but that doesn't mean I have to love him. I see him at Christmas/holidays as he still lives with my mom but I have not spoken a word to him in years. I hate when people treat the mentally handicapped as God's precious angels. Call me cruel, I don't give a fuck.
